2607.17038.title: Reward-Driven LLM Agent Workflows: Synthesizing POMDP Routing and Self-Correction for Autonomous Decision-Making
2607.17038.paper_summary: This paper addresses key technical challenges in current large language model (LLM) agent applications, including long-horizon planning, sparse reward attribution, and dynamic environmental interaction, by designing and optimizing an intelligent agent workflow. The proposed architecture is based on the synthesis of core AI paradigms: Visual, Language, Generative, Graph, Multimodal, Reinforcement, and Agent Intelligence. Unlike conventional baseline models that rely on static prompting and lack robust perception-action loops, our approach introduces a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) routing mechanism. This mechanism is augmented with an internal, self-correcting reward model that evaluates decision trajectories before execution. By integrating multimodal inputs and advanced reinforcement learning principles (such as proximal policy optimization and value function approximation), the agent maintains long-term structural memory and dynamically adapts its reasoning pathways to mitigate error accumulation. Empirical experiments on the ALFWorld embodied simulation environment and the WebShop online navigation benchmark demonstrate a 24.5% absolute improvement in task success rate and trajectory efficiency over mainstream baselines like the standard ReAct framework. Comprehensive ablation studies confirm the significant contribution of the reward-driven critique module in suppressing hallucination rates. This research bridges theoretical foundations of reinforcement learning and graph-based memory with autonomous agent workflows. Ultimately, the resulting architecture offers a practical, scalable reference framework for developing artificial intelligence technologies in complex, multi-step autonomous systems. Code is available at https://github.com/01Amez/RLAW_Implementation.
2607.17038.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文針對當前大型語言模型（LLM）代理應用中的關鍵技術挑戰進行探討，包括長期規劃、稀疏獎勵歸因和動態環境互動，通過設計和優化智能代理工作流程來解決這些問題。所提出的架構基於核心人工智慧範式的綜合：視覺、語言、生成、圖形、多模態、強化和代理智慧。與依賴靜態提示且缺乏穩健感知-行動循環的傳統基線模型不同，我們的方法引入了一種部分可觀察馬爾可夫決策過程（POMDP）路由機制。這一機制增強了一個內部的自我修正獎勵模型，該模型在執行之前評估決策軌跡。通過整合多模態輸入和先進的強化學習原則（如近端策略優化和價值函數逼近），該代理維持長期結構記憶並動態調整其推理路徑以減少錯誤累積。在ALFWorld具身模擬環境和WebShop在線導航基準上的實證實驗顯示，任務成功率和軌跡效率相比主流基線（如標準ReAct框架）有24.5%的絕對提升。全面的消融研究確認了以獎勵驅動的批評模塊在抑制幻覺率方面的重要貢獻。本研究橋接了強化學習和基於圖形的記憶的理論基礎與自主代理工作流程。最終，所產生的架構為在複雜的多步自主系統中開發人工智慧技術提供了一個實用、可擴展的參考框架。代碼可在 https://github.com/01Amez/RLAW_Implementation 獲得。
